index.threshold: the index pad within 3 mm of the trigger face at the rest curl, the finger clear of the frame

right_seat.used: palm centre on Grip, axial offset 0.0 mm, back 0.0 mm (the clear seat nearest the SMG's rule) (no hand turn up to 45 deg lets the thumb wrap the grip's left side)

ik_right.what: right arm to the held grip, the scope's EyePoint on the right eye

ik_left_A.what: left arm to the seated SupportHand hold

ik_left_B.what: left arm to the seated SupportHandBipod hold (upper body as standing: proxy for prone)

left_A_reach.note: square stance = the fit body's rest torso facing the target with the bore under the right eye (the SMG's assumption); real standing / kneeling holds blade the torso, which brings the left shoulder forward

measurements.length_of_pull_rule: trigger blade face (Z B 21.13) to the butt pad rear (min X of the body bone's vertices)
measurements.trigger_reach_rule: spec web point (hollow) -> trigger blade face
measurements.grip_girth_rule: section perpendicular to the grip axis, 25 / 46 / 70 mm down from the web point (the W1 early method), on the shipped body-bone bytes
measurements.eye_source: right eyeball island of FIT_MH_PlayerDefault_HeadParts (289 verts): centre [-33.3, -92.2, 1744.9]

cheek_riser.rule: rays straight up from a 4 mm grid on the riser's top face to the FIT head mesh, the eye on EyePoint, bore level, the head upright and neutral; the smallest gap = the raise that brings the comb to the face (negative = the face would sit inside the rest riser)

cheek_weld_head_pose.note: no cant / pitch up to 40 deg puts the face on the riser inside its travel; the least-penetrating pose's gap is the riser change it would need

cheek_riser.cheek_weld_rule: head rotated about neck_01's head (cant = right ear down about the forward axis, then pitch = nod forward), torso fixed, the gun level and straight with EyePoint on the moved eye; the pose with the least cant + pitch whose face-to-riser gap lies inside the riser travel (the raise that brings the comb to the cheek)

shoulder_pocket.pocket_rule: the front skin straight ahead of the point midway between the clavicle head and the right shoulder joint, 10 mm below the joint
shoulder_pocket.how: with the eye on EyePoint and the head upright the butt pad sits 'down' mm above and 'toward_right' mm left of the pocket: the shooter closes it by dropping the head onto the comb, canting the head and raising the shoulder (the real cheek weld); fore-aft, a butt 'back' mm in front of the pocket means the eye ends that much nearer the eyepiece

hand_offset.frame: hand_r bone (MH_PlayerDefault metahuman_base_skel, Blender armature axes)

SupportHand.why: the socket is socket_to_surface_point_mm inside the forend above the palm's contact face; in the square stance the left arm reaches only to the X given

SupportHandBipod.why: the socket is socket_to_surface_point_mm inside the butt above its underside

socket_proposals.Grip: keep (frame origin; the hand seats with the palm centre on it, 0 offsets)
socket_proposals.Shoulder: keep (the butt-pad rear centre; the pocket gap is a posture matter, see measurements.shoulder_pocket)

threshold: palm penetration <= 1 mm (each hand); index pad 0..3 mm from the trigger face at the rest curl, the finger clear of the frame; 0 hand-gun triangle pairs / penetrations at rest and every clip extreme (both hands, both poses); the three two-bone IKs < 0.5 mm with the elbow inside 0..150 deg; grip girth at 46 mm <= 167 mm; trigger reach <= 80 mm (W1 early bands). Reported, not gated: length of pull, eye relief, riser raise, shoulder pocket
note: measured on the locked fit body in Blender on the shipped Exports/Guns/SR01 bytes; no export touched
render_note: cheek-weld posture (measurements.cheek_riser.cheek_weld_head_pose) when found; arms posed analytically (two-bone, elbow pole down / out) to the hold transforms, fingers at the measured poses; pose B keeps the standing upper body (a proxy for prone: the gun-to-head and hand-to-gun relation is the gated part, the torso / legs are not posed prone)
